specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: 66.5Wh cell (larger than 13-inch); up to 18h video / 15h web claimed.

offers.name: Apple MacBook Air 15.3" w/ Touch ID (2026) - Silver (Apple M5 / 16GB RAM / 512GB SSD) - English

reviews.quote: There is just nothing comparable in the Windows world.
The Apple MacBook Air 13 M5 is a premium ultraportable laptop... keeps the same compact, fanless design.
The MacBook Air M5 is the sum of years of refinements, with a mix of premium design, strong performance, and solid battery life.

praises: Big 15.3-inch screen at only 1.51 kg — the lightest big-screen laptop anyone sells (NBC)
Six-speaker array with force-cancelling woofers is genuinely good for video and calls (NBC)
Bigger battery than the 13-inch: easily 2 workdays of light use (Amazon.ca reviewers)
Still totally fanless and silent despite the larger chassis
Base 16GB/512GB config is a fair starting point — no entry-level RAM tax
complaints: Soldered RAM and storage; 24GB costs +C$300 and can't be added later (NBC's top con)
No Face ID — Touch ID only, which feels old on a 2026 Mac (NBC con)
Only two Thunderbolt ports for a desktop-replacement-sized machine (NBC con)
60Hz notched LCD; ProMotion reserved for the Pro line
Fanless design throttles long exports despite the roomier chassis

design_philosophy: The Air 15 is the 'one screen size up, nothing else changes' option: same M5, same fanless silence, more display, more speakers, bigger battery. NBC's verdict is that nothing in the Windows world matches its combination.
rating_notes: Directly tested by Notebookcheck (92%). RTINGS score quoted from the same-generation 13-inch M5 review (identical platform). Image URL follows Apple's specs-page CDN pattern; site fallback applies if it rotates. Sentiment from NBC cons + Amazon.ca aggregate; Reddit API blocked (403).
